content.user_title: Migrate Legacy Azure CallingServer Java Code
content.value_statement: Legacy CallingServer Java projects need clear migration guidance because the SDK is deprecated. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code map old Azure Communication Services patterns to Call Automation.
actual_capabilities: Shows the Maven dependency change to azure-communication-callautomation.
Maps legacy CallingServer classes to Call Automation classes.
Compares legacy and replacement client creation patterns.
Summarizes legacy call recording operations and the migration direction.
limitations: It is for legacy maintenance, not new Azure calling projects.
It does not provide runnable scripts or automated refactoring.
It covers a narrow CallingServer to Call Automation migration path.
It does not replace current Azure SDK documentation.

use_cases.title: Plan a Legacy SDK Migration
use_cases.description: Review deprecated dependencies and identify the replacement Call Automation package.

use_cases.title: Update Azure Calling Client Names
use_cases.description: Map old CallingServer classes to the newer Call Automation client classes.

use_cases.title: Review Call Recording Changes
use_cases.description: Understand legacy recording methods before moving related code to Call Automation.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Deprecated Usage
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one Java service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Java service for Azure CallingServer usage and explain which parts are deprecated.

prompt_templates.title: Map Classes
prompt_templates.prompt: List the CallingServer classes in this codebase and map each one to the Call Automation replacement.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Dependency Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Maven dependency plan and describe the steps to move from CallingServer to Call Automation.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Recording Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of call recording behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this legacy call recording flow and describe the Call Automation migration risks and test cases.

output_examples.input: Find deprecated CallingServer usage in my service.
output_examples.output: A migration note that names the deprecated dependency, identifies affected client classes, and recommends Call Automation replacements.

output_examples.input: Explain how to replace legacy call recording methods.
output_examples.output: A concise review of recording operations, required migration checks, and follow-up documentation areas.

output_examples.input: Create a migration checklist for this module.

best_practices: Use this skill only when maintaining existing CallingServer code.
Verify migration details against current Azure SDK documentation.
Add tests around calling and recording behavior before changing SDK clients.
anti_patterns: Do not start new projects with azure-communication-callingserver.
Do not assume class names are the only migration change.
Do not migrate production calling flows without behavior tests.

faq.question: Is CallingServer recommended for new Java projects?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that new projects should use Azure Communication Call Automation.

faq.question: Does this skill install Azure SDK packages?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation guidance and examples only.

faq.question: Can this skill update my code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can guide changes, but it does not include an automated refactoring tool.

faq.question: Which package replaces azure-communication-callingserver?
faq.answer: The skill points to azure-communication-callautomation as the replacement package.

faq.question: Does it cover call recording?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes legacy recording operations and points users toward Call Automation for new work.

faq.question: Should I verify versions before migration?
faq.answer: Yes. Check current Azure SDK documentation before choosing package versions.
